# Equity Performance Mixed as Market Leadership Shifts Beneath the Surface. ##### by Sequoia Financial Group. U.S. equity markets delivered mixed performance this week, underscoring elevated dispersion in returns and ongoing shifts in market leadership. So far in 2026, market leadership has rotated away from large-cap growth stocks toward more cyclical, small-cap, and value segments. Small caps are outperforming their large-cap peers by over six per cent year to date, while value has outperformed growth by nearly 10 per cent. The recent dispersion in returns highlights the importance of maintaining a diversified equity portfolio as leadership continues to shift across sectors and styles. According to FactSet, the S&P 500 currently has a blended earnings growth rate of 12.9 per cent, notably higher than the 8 per cent growth expected at the start of the year. The views are subject to change and are not intended as a forecast or guarantee of future results.
